architecture_summary: A full-stack Next.js 14 chatbot application with multi-provider LLM support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure, Mistral, Groq, Perplexity, OpenRouter). Features include workspace-based multi-tenancy, RAG with file embedding and semantic retrieval, assistant management with tools and retrieval, i18n support via next-i18n-router, Supabase Auth with JWT middleware protection, and a comprehensive UI component library built on Radix UI with Tailwind CSS styling.
key_patterns: Multi-provider LLM API routes with streaming support
RAG pipeline with file processing (PDF, DOCX, CSV, JSON, MD, TXT)
i18n routing with dynamic locale segments
Server Actions and App Router patterns
Custom model support with context length limits
Assistant tools with custom function calling
